answer: Work-slot deposit burn digs a cost canyon between one honest agent and a sybil farm. To claim a slot, an agent locks 20 credits in a vault; the deposit burns if the slot idles or the agent cheats, and returns after 10 epochs of work. Each identity needs its own deposit, so 1,000 fakes burn 20,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 20 once and earns it back in fees. The delta: the farm's burn grows with every fake, the honest cost stays flat.
